mapper.select: SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.module.selectSessionModule */ SESSION_ID as sessionId, MODULE_ID as moduleId, SESSION_MODULE_CONFIG as sessionModuleConfig FROM SESSION_MODULE WHERE SESSION_ID = #{sessionId} AND MODULE_ID = #{moduleId}

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.module.selectListSessionModule */ SESSION_ID as sessionId, MODULE_ID as moduleId, SESSION_MODULE_CONFIG as sessionModuleConfig FROM ( SELECT S.*, CEIL( (@ROWNUM:=@ROWNUM+1) / #{pageSize} ) AS PAGE FROM ( SELECT * FROM SESSION_MODULE WHERE 1=1
) S, (SELECT @ROWNUM := 0) TMP ) A WHERE PAGE = #{pageIndex}
SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.module.selectListCountSessionModule */ COUNT(*) totcnt FROM SESSION_MODULE WHERE 1=1

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.module.selectListSessionModuleDetailBySessionId */ sm.SESSION_ID as sessionId, sm.MODULE_ID as moduleId, sm.SESSION_MODULE_CONFIG as sessionModuleConfig, m.CODE as code, m.NAME as name, m.DESCRIPTION as description, m.ICON as icon FROM SESSION_MODULE sm INNER JOIN MODULE m ON sm.MODULE_ID = m.MODULE_ID WHERE sm.SESSION_ID = #{sessionId} ORDER BY sm.MODULE_ID
